entries.title: Quick explanations ask for low intelligence
entries.body: A question about how or why something works, answered from what Infinitary can already read - your Mac, and the current state of the computers and GitHub checks it connects to - now asks for a low-intelligence crewmate, like a fact lookup. When the answer needs more than that, such as comparing past runs, a reproduction or the web, its card says what is not yet established and offers Look deeper, which starts a research step built on it. Usage lists these answers as Lookups and explanations.

picture.alt: An explanation's task record shows Low intelligence and Looking up or explaining from what is here beneath its model
